title: Gender and content bias in Large Language Models: a case study on Google Gemini 2.0 Flash Experimental
benchmark_measurement: The benchmark did not measure any aspect of faith or religion. It focused on content bias (sexual, violent, drug-related) and gender bias.
findings: This paper does not contain any findings related to religion as it was not a focus of the study.
